newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Baan says software complies with year 2000.
newsitem.headline: Baan says software complies with year 2000.

text.p: Computer software firm Baan said on Tuesday the year 2000 would not lead to any accounting, inventory or other data-related problems for its clients.

Baan said all products from its Triton III software package onwards were year 2000-compliant, while customers using Triton II or earlier versions who had a technical support contract would be given a free update to ensure year 2000 compliance.
"The fact that Baan has Millenium-proofed its software means one less application that our customers have to worry about," said Doug Sallen, vice-president of corporate marketing, in a statement.
